comment: M01 golden-slice art review. Eye-height spectator views of every room on the authored route, with the dormant guards in place. Look at each still against docs/design/earth.md and the art bible; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence.

states.note: Arrival: queue lane, recall notice, Annex 67 over the door.

states.note: Sealed repair stalls and the canopy lamps.
